title: Fact
description: One number or named thing the engine computed or read, with what it rests on. Every number said to the user is also a fact. The definitions below are shared by the other schemas.

type.description: What the fact is, snake_case, e.g. walking_distance, barrier, route_violating_crossings.

value.description: The value as said to the user (rounded). null when the data does not say.

source.description: computed: engine calculation on the map; map_tag: read from an OSM tag; transit_api: Transitous; web: web search result; estimated: an estimate, always said as one; unknown: said by the user or not backed by data.

evidence.description: OSM ids (node/123, way/456, relation/7) or URLs.

inputs.description: Coordinates, parameters and snapshot date that produced the value, enough to recompute it.

completeness.description: unknown when the result could depend on paths or features outside the downloaded area.

user_text.description: Said to the user: obeys the speaking rules in docs/speaking-rules.md; every number in it is also in facts[].

relative_direction.description: Relative to the user's facing; only valid once a heading is established.

unknown.description: What the data does not say, said out loud.
